name: @leejkee/obs-live-overlay
description: 由本地控制台管理、用于 OBS Browser Source 的 Overlay 工具

scripts.install: node -e "/* Native builds are explicit; packaged prebuilds need no compiler. */"
scripts.configure:native: cmake-js configure --directory src/native --out build/native --generator Ninja --arch x64 --CDSMTC_BUILD_FIXTURE=OFF
scripts.build:native: npm run configure:native && cmake-js build --directory src/native --out build/native --generator Ninja --arch x64 --target smtc-addon
scripts.build:native:fixture: cmake-js configure --directory src/native --out build/native --generator Ninja --arch x64 --CDSMTC_BUILD_FIXTURE=ON && cmake-js build --directory src/native --out build/native --generator Ninja --arch x64 --target smtc_fixture
scripts.configure:native:prebuild: cmake-js configure --directory src/native --out build/native-prebuild --generator Ninja --arch x64 --runtime-version 20.0.0 --CDSMTC_BUILD_FIXTURE=OFF
scripts.package:native: npm run configure:native:prebuild && cmake --build build/native-prebuild --config Release --target smtc-addon && node scripts/package-native.cjs
scripts.test:native: npm run build && node --test test/native/loader.test.cjs test/native/runtime.test.cjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
